# Data sets 

We use the following data sets to validate findings from MB119: 

  - *in-vivo IM/Atrophy* data sets:
     - Nookaew et al., BMC Medical Genomics 2013. GSE27411. n=3 samples from non-infected patients (antrum and corpus) and unpaired samples from patients with atrophy (antrum and corpus). Illumina humanRef-8 v2.0 beadchip.
     - Companioni et al., PlosOne 2017. GSE78523. n=15 (11 Antrum, 4 Body). Affymetrix Human Almac Xcel Array
     - Thorell et al., Infection & Immunity 2017 (DOI: 10.1128/IAI.00031-17). E-MTAB-3689; n=25 RNA-Seq of gastritis, mild atrophy, extensive atrophy/IM
     
  - *in-vitro* data sets of stomach and intestine:
     - Colon (van Wetering et al.; DOI 10.1016/j.cell.2015.03.053) vs. Stomach (Bartfeld et al. Gastroenterology 2015. GSE60557. 2A/2C gland derived organoids). Both hybridized to Affymetrix Human Gene 2.0 ST Arrays. 
     - Kayisoglu et al. (Bartfeld lab, DOI 10.1136/gutjnl-2019-319919). GSE127938. 3 samples each from human stomach antrum + corpus ("stomach"), cranial intestine (duodenum, jejunum) and caudal intestine (ileum, colon) cultured as organoids and subjected to RNA-Seq
     - Zhenshou/China Small intestine vs. stomach
     
  - *ex-vivo* data sets of healthy and metaplastic stomach
     - Zhenshou/China IM vs non-IM 
     - MPIIB ESGIv2 IM vs. non-IM
          
For each data set we compare Atrophy/IM vs. healthy/control conditions in stomach or large/small intestine vs. stomach samples.      

```{r}
data_folder_validation <- "../../../../Data/ExtData/Validation_DataSets"
```


## Nookaew et al. 

Normalized data was downloaded from GEO and gene annotations were updated based on RefSeq accessions (2016).

```{r}
nookaew_env_dge = new.env()
load(file.path(data_folder_validation, "GSE27411_Hpy_gastric_atrophy/analysis/Results/2020-03-04/DGE_analysis_image.Rdata"), nookaew_env_dge)

tmp = get("normalized",nookaew_env_dge)
# probe annotation must include gene symbol, probe ID and optionally a transcript ID
tmp_dge = get("all_results", nookaew_env_dge)

tmp_anno = tmp_dge[[1]][, c("GB_ACC","Row.names", "SYMBOL")]
colnames(tmp_anno) = gsub("GB_ACC","TX_ID", gsub("Row.names","PROBE_ID",colnames(tmp_anno)))

# sample annotation must include sample ID and stomach site
tmp_ed = get("ed", nookaew_env_dge)
colnames(tmp_ed) = gsub("sample_ID","SampleID", gsub("site","Site", colnames(tmp_ed)))
tmp_ed$Cohort = paste0("Nookaew IM",",",tmp_ed$Site)
sel_samples = subset(tmp_ed, condition != "Hpy infected")
sel_samples$Condition = ifelse(sel_samples$condition == "non-infected", "healthy stomach", "intestinal/-like")

sel_comps = c("Atrophy_vs_NI_Antrum","Atrophy_vs_NI_Corpus")

data_nookaew = list(emat = tmp[, sel_samples$SampleID], anno = tmp_anno[, c("SYMBOL","PROBE_ID","TX_ID")], sample_description=sel_samples[, c("SampleID","Condition","Cohort")], dge = tmp_dge[sel_comps])
rm(tmp_ed, tmp_dge, tmp, tmp_anno, sel_samples, sel_comps)
rm(nookaew_env_dge)
```

## Companioni et al.

Normalized data was downloaded from GEO. Probesets with less than 90% aligned proportion were excluded. We only include antrum samples since there anyway only few corpus and transitional samples.

```{r}
# companioni_env = new.env()
# load(file.path(data_folder_validation,  "GSE78523_IM_GC/data_GSE78523_full.Rdata", companioni_env)
companioni_env_dge = new.env()
load(file.path(data_folder_validation,  "GSE78523_IM_GC/Results/2022-02-23/DGE_results.Rdata"), companioni_env_dge)

tmp = get("normalized",companioni_env_dge)
          
# probe annotation must include gene symbol, probe ID and optionally a transcript ID
tmp_anno = get("anno", companioni_env_dge)
tmp_anno = as.data.frame(lapply(tmp_anno, as.character))
colnames(tmp_anno) = gsub("Gene.Symbol", "SYMBOL", gsub("Representative.Public.PROBE_ID","TX_ID", gsub("ID","PROBE_ID",colnames(tmp_anno))))

tmp_anno$alignment_proportion = as.numeric(unlist(sapply(strsplit(as.character(tmp_anno$Alignments)," // "), `[`,2)))
sel_probes = subset(tmp_anno, !is.na(alignment_proportion) & alignment_proportion > 90)$PROBE_ID
rownames(tmp_anno) = tmp_anno$PROBE_ID

# sample annotation must include sample ID and stomach site

tmp_ed = get("pheno", companioni_env_dge)
colnames(tmp_ed) = gsub("geo_accession","SampleID", gsub("source_tissue","Site", colnames(tmp_ed)))
tmp_ed$Cohort = "Companioni IM"
tmp_ed$SampleID = as.character(tmp_ed$SampleID)
sel_samples = subset(tmp_ed, grepl("Control", pathology) & Site == "Antrum")
sel_samples$Condition = ifelse(sel_samples$pathology=="Healthy Control","healthy stomach","intestinal/-like")

tmp_dge = get("all_results", companioni_env_dge)

sel_comps = c("IM_vs_healthy")

data_companioni = list(emat = tmp[sel_probes, sel_samples$SampleID], anno = tmp_anno[sel_probes, c("SYMBOL","PROBE_ID","TX_ID")], sample_description=sel_samples[, c("SampleID","Condition","Cohort")], dge = tmp_dge[sel_comps])
rm(tmp_ed, tmp_dge, tmp, tmp_anno, sel_samples, sel_comps, sel_genes, sel_probes)
rm(companioni_env_dge)
```

## Kayisoglu / Bartfeld et al. RNA-Seq data

```{r}
kayisoglu_env = new.env()
load(file.path(data_folder_validation,  "GSE127938_Bartfeld_gut_organoids/analysis/GSE127938_human_RNASeq.Rdata"), kayisoglu_env)
kayisoglu_env_dge = new.env()
load(file.path(data_folder_validation,  "GSE127938_Bartfeld_gut_organoids/analysis/Results/2022-02-24/Bartfeld_DGE_all.Rdata"), kayisoglu_env_dge)

tmp = get("normalized",kayisoglu_env_dge)

# probe annotation must include gene symbol, probe ID and optionally a transcript ID
tmp_anno = get("human_gene_anno",kayisoglu_env )
tmp_anno$PROBE_ID = rownames(tmp_anno)
tmp_anno$TX_ID=""
colnames(tmp_anno) = gsub("GeneSymbol", "SYMBOL", colnames(tmp_anno))

# sample annotation must include sample ID and stomach site
tmp_ed = get("ed", kayisoglu_env_dge)
tmp_ed$Site = ifelse(tmp_ed$tissue %in% c("stomach corpus", "stomach pylorus"), "stomach", ifelse(tmp_ed$tissue %in% c("colon","ileum"), "caudal intestine", "cranial intestine"))
colnames(tmp_ed) = gsub("sampleID","SampleID", colnames(tmp_ed))

tmp_dge = get("all_results", kayisoglu_env_dge)

# Cranial intestine vs. stomach
sel_samples = subset(tmp_ed, Site %in% c("stomach","cranial intestine"))
sel_samples$Cohort = "Kayisoglu, Cranial intestine"
sel_samples$Condition = ifelse(sel_samples$Site == "stomach", "Healthy stomach", "Intestinal/-like")

sel_comps = "Stomach_vs_Cranial"
  
data_kayisoglu_cranial = list(emat = tmp[, sel_samples$SampleID], anno = tmp_anno[, c("SYMBOL","PROBE_ID","TX_ID")], sample_description=sel_samples[, c("SampleID","Condition","Cohort")], dge = tmp_dge[sel_comps])

# Caudal intestine vs. stomach
sel_samples = subset(tmp_ed, Site %in% c("stomach","caudal intestine"))
sel_samples$Cohort = "Kayisoglu, Caudal intestine"
sel_samples$Condition = ifelse(sel_samples$Site == "stomach", "Healthy stomach", "Intestinal/-like")

sel_comps = "Stomach_vs_Caudal"

data_kayisoglu_caudal = list(emat = tmp[, sel_samples$SampleID], anno = tmp_anno[, c("SYMBOL","PROBE_ID","TX_ID")], sample_description=sel_samples[, c("SampleID","Condition","Cohort")], dge = tmp_dge[sel_comps])

rm(tmp_ed, tmp_dge, tmp, tmp_anno, sel_samples, sel_comps)
rm(kayisoglu_env, kayisoglu_env_dge)
```


## Thorell et al. RNA-Seq data

```{r}
thorell_env_dge = new.env()
load(file.path(data_folder_validation,  "E-MTAB-3689_gastric_inflammation_metaplasia/analysis/DGE-Analysis/Results/2017-11-30/DGE_analysis_image.Rdata"), thorell_env_dge)

tmp_mat = get("count_mat",thorell_env_dge)

# probe annotation must include gene symbol, probe ID and optionally a transcript ID
tmp_anno = get("gene_anno",thorell_env_dge)
tmp_anno$PROBE_ID = rownames(tmp_anno)
tmp_anno$TX_ID=rownames(tmp_anno)
colnames(tmp_anno) = gsub("GeneSymbol", "SYMBOL", colnames(tmp_anno))

# sample annotation must include sample ID and stomach site
tmp_ed = get("ed", thorell_env_dge)
colnames(tmp_ed) = gsub("ENA_Run_ID","SampleID", colnames(tmp_ed))

tmp = assay(vst(DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(tmp_mat, colData = tmp_ed[colnames(tmp_mat),], design = ~ DiseaseStaging)))

tmp_dge = get("all_results", thorell_env_dge)

# Atrophy vs. normal
sel_samples = subset(tmp_ed, DiseaseStaging %in% c("normal","Atrophy") & !Source.Name %in% c("Gast6","EA6","Atr8")) # exclude 3 outlier samples
sel_samples$Cohort = "Thorell, Atrophy"
sel_samples$Condition = ifelse(sel_samples$DiseaseStaging == "normal", "Healthy stomach", "Intestinal/-like")

sel_comps = "Atrophy_vs_normal_good_samp"
  
data_thorell_atrophy = list(emat = tmp[, sel_samples$SampleID], anno = tmp_anno[, c("SYMBOL","PROBE_ID","TX_ID")], sample_description=sel_samples[, c("SampleID","Condition","Cohort")], dge = tmp_dge[sel_comps])

# Extensive atrophy vs. normal
sel_samples = subset(tmp_ed, DiseaseStaging %in% c("normal","Extensive atrophy") & !Source.Name %in% c("Gast6","EA6","Atr8"))
sel_samples$Cohort = "Thorell, Ext. atrophy"
sel_samples$Condition = ifelse(sel_samples$DiseaseStaging == "normal", "Healthy stomach", "Intestinal/-like")

sel_comps = "ExtAtrophy_vs_normal_good_samp"

data_thorell_extatrophy = list(emat = tmp[, sel_samples$SampleID], anno = tmp_anno[, c("SYMBOL","PROBE_ID","TX_ID")], sample_description=sel_samples[, c("SampleID","Condition","Cohort")], dge = tmp_dge[sel_comps])


rm(tmp_ed, tmp_dge, tmp, tmp_anno, tmp_mat, sel_samples, sel_comps)
rm(thorell_env_dge)
```

## Colon biobank (van de Wetering et al., Bartfeld et al.)


```{r}
colon_env_dge = new.env()
load(file.path(data_folder_validation,  "GSE64392_colon_biobank/analysis/Results/2022-02-24/DGE_analysis_image.Rdata"), colon_env_dge)

tmp = get("expr_mat",colon_env_dge)

tmp_dge = get("all_results", colon_env_dge)

# probe annotation must include gene symbol, probe ID and optionally a transcript ID
tmp_anno = tmp_dge[[1]][, c("Row.names", "SYMBOL")]
colnames(tmp_anno) = gsub("Row.names","PROBE_ID",colnames(tmp_anno))
tmp_anno$TX_ID = tmp_anno$PROBE_ID

# sample annotation must include sample ID and stomach site
tmp_ed = get("ed", colon_env_dge)
colnames(tmp_ed) = gsub("ID","SampleID", colnames(tmp_ed))
tmp_ed$Cohort = "van de Wetering,Colon"
sel_samples = tmp_ed
sel_samples$Condition = ifelse(sel_samples$Organ == "Stomach", "healthy stomach", "intestinal/-like")

sel_comps = c("colon_vs_stomach_glands")

data_van_de_wetering = list(emat = tmp[, sel_samples$SampleID], anno = tmp_anno[, c("SYMBOL","PROBE_ID","TX_ID")], sample_description=sel_samples[, c("SampleID","Condition","Cohort")], dge = tmp_dge[sel_comps])
rm(tmp_ed, tmp_dge, tmp, tmp_anno, sel_samples, sel_comps)
rm(colon_env_dge)
```

# iPSC CDX2 Knock-in

```{r}

tmp_tab<- readRDS(file.path(data_folder_validation,  "GSE173264_iPSC_CDX2/GSE173264_iPSC_CDX2_mat.rds")) |> as.data.frame()

#tmp_dge = get("all_results", colon_env_dge)

tmp <- as.matrix(tmp_tab[, 3:ncol(tmp_tab)])
rownames(tmp) <- tmp_tab$`Gene ID`

# probe annotation must include gene symbol, probe ID and optionally a transcript ID
tmp_anno = tmp_tab[, c("Gene ID", "GeneSymbol")]
colnames(tmp_anno) = gsub("Gene ID","PROBE_ID",colnames(tmp_anno))
colnames(tmp_anno) = gsub("GeneSymbol","SYMBOL",colnames(tmp_anno))
tmp_anno$TX_ID = tmp_anno$PROBE_ID

# sample annotation must include sample ID and stomach site
tmp_ed = data.frame(SampleID=colnames(tmp))
tmp_ed$Cohort = "GSE173264, iPSC"
tmp_ed$Condition = ifelse(grepl("DOX[-_]N$", tmp_ed$SampleID),"healthy stomach", "intestinal/-like")
sel_samples = tmp_ed

#sel_comps = c("colon_vs_stomach_glands")

data_ipsc = list(emat = tmp[, sel_samples$SampleID], anno = tmp_anno[, c("SYMBOL","PROBE_ID","TX_ID")], sample_description=sel_samples[, c("SampleID","Condition","Cohort")], dge = NA)
rm(tmp_ed, tmp, tmp_anno, sel_samples)

```



# ESGI v2

```{r}
esgiv2env_dge = new.env()
load("../../../../Results/ClonalCultures/RNA/DGE_analysis_image.Rdata", esgiv2env_dge)

# probe annotation must include gene symbol, probe ID and optionally a transcript ID
tmp_dge = get("all_results", esgiv2env_dge)

tmp_anno = get("gene_anno", esgiv2env_dge)
colnames(tmp_anno) = gsub("GeneSymbol", "SYMBOL", gsub("Geneid","PROBE_ID",colnames(tmp_anno)))
tmp_anno$TX_ID = tmp_anno$PROBE_ID

# sample annotation must include sample ID and stomach site
tmp_ed = get("ed", esgiv2env_dge)
colnames(tmp_ed) = gsub("Library.number","SampleID", colnames(tmp_ed))

tmp_mat = get("count_mat",esgiv2env_dge)
tmp = assay(vst(DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(tmp_mat, colData = tmp_ed[colnames(tmp_mat),], design = ~ Condition)))

# IM vs. Normal Antrum
sel_samples = subset(tmp_ed, Condition %in% c("IM","Normal Antrum"))
sel_samples$Condition = ifelse(sel_samples$Condition == "Normal Antrum", "healthy stomach", "intestinal/-like")
sel_samples$Cohort = "evC IM vs normal"

sel_comps = c("IM_all_vs_NormalAntrum")

data_esgiv2_IM_vs_normal = list(emat = tmp[, sel_samples$SampleID], anno = tmp_anno[, c("SYMBOL","PROBE_ID","TX_ID")], sample_description=sel_samples[, c("SampleID","Condition","Cohort")], dge = tmp_dge[sel_comps])

# IM vs non-IM, alll patients
sel_samples = subset(tmp_ed, Condition %in% c("IM","Non-IM"))
sel_samples$Condition = ifelse(sel_samples$Condition == "Non-IM", "healthy stomach", "intestinal/-like")
sel_samples$Cohort = "evC IM vs non-IM"

sel_comps = c("IM_vs_non-IM_all_samples")

data_esgiv2_IM_vs_nonIM = list(emat = tmp[, sel_samples$SampleID], anno = tmp_anno[, c("SYMBOL","PROBE_ID","TX_ID")], sample_description=sel_samples[, c("SampleID","Condition","Cohort")], dge = tmp_dge[sel_comps])


# IM vs non-IM, P591
sel_samples = subset(tmp_ed, Condition %in% c("IM","Non-IM") & Patient == "591")
sel_samples$Condition = ifelse(sel_samples$Condition == "Non-IM", "healthy stomach", "intestinal/-like")
sel_samples$Cohort = "evC IM vs non-IM, P591"

sel_comps = c("IM_591_vs_NonIM")

data_esgiv2_IM_vs_nonIM_591 = list(emat = tmp[, sel_samples$SampleID], anno = tmp_anno[, c("SYMBOL","PROBE_ID","TX_ID")], sample_description=sel_samples[, c("SampleID","Condition","Cohort")], dge = tmp_dge[sel_comps])

# IM vs non-IM, P592
sel_samples = subset(tmp_ed, Condition %in% c("IM","Non-IM") & Patient == "592")
sel_samples$Condition = ifelse(sel_samples$Condition == "Non-IM", "healthy stomach", "intestinal/-like")
sel_samples$Cohort = "evC IM vs non-IM, P592"

sel_comps = c("IM_592_vs_NonIM")

data_esgiv2_IM_vs_nonIM_592 = list(emat = tmp[, sel_samples$SampleID], anno = tmp_anno[, c("SYMBOL","PROBE_ID","TX_ID")], sample_description=sel_samples[, c("SampleID","Condition","Cohort")], dge = tmp_dge[sel_comps])

# IM vs non-IM, P594
sel_samples = subset(tmp_ed, Condition %in% c("IM","Non-IM") & Patient == "594")
sel_samples$Condition = ifelse(sel_samples$Condition == "Non-IM", "healthy stomach", "intestinal/-like")
sel_samples$Cohort = "evC IM vs non-IM, P594"

sel_comps = c("IM_594_vs_NonIM")

data_esgiv2_IM_vs_nonIM_594 = list(emat = tmp[, sel_samples$SampleID], anno = tmp_anno[, c("SYMBOL","PROBE_ID","TX_ID")], sample_description=sel_samples[, c("SampleID","Condition","Cohort")], dge = tmp_dge[sel_comps])


rm(tmp_ed, tmp_dge, tmp, tmp_anno, sel_samples, sel_comps)
rm(esgiv2env_dge)
```

# IM China

```{r}
im_china_env_dge = new.env()
load("../../../../Results/PolyclonalCultures/RNA/DGE_analysis_image.Rdata", im_china_env_dge)

# probe annotation must include gene symbol, probe ID and optionally a transcript ID
tmp_dge = get("all_results", im_china_env_dge)

tmp_anno = get("gene_anno", im_china_env_dge)
colnames(tmp_anno) = gsub("GeneSymbol", "SYMBOL", gsub("Geneid","PROBE_ID",colnames(tmp_anno)))
tmp_anno$TX_ID = tmp_anno$PROBE_ID

# sample annotation must include sample ID and stomach site
tmp_ed = get("ed", im_china_env_dge)
colnames(tmp_ed) = gsub("sampleID","SampleID", colnames(tmp_ed))

tmp_mat = get("count_mat",im_china_env_dge)
tmp = assay(vst(DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(tmp_mat, colData = tmp_ed[colnames(tmp_mat),], design = ~ Group)))

# IM vs non-IM
sel_samples = subset(tmp_ed, (is.na(tmp_ed$`Histological diagnosis`) | (tmp_ed$`Histological diagnosis` == "IM")) & Site %in% c("Angular incisisure", "Antrum","Corpus")  & Group %in% c("IM","Non-IM")) 
sel_samples$Condition = ifelse(sel_samples$Group == "Non-IM", "healthy stomach", "intestinal/-like")
sel_samples$Cohort = "evPC IM vs Non-IM"

sel_comps = c("IM_vs_non-IM_all")

data_im_china = list(emat = tmp[, sel_samples$SampleID], anno = tmp_anno[, c("SYMBOL","PROBE_ID","TX_ID")], sample_description=sel_samples[, c("SampleID","Condition","Cohort")], dge = tmp_dge[sel_comps])

# stomach vs. SI
sel_samples = subset(tmp_ed, (is.na(tmp_ed$`Histological diagnosis`)) & Site %in% c("Antrum","Corpus", "small intestinal") & Group == "Control" ) 
sel_samples$Condition = ifelse(sel_samples$Site %in% c("Antrum","Corpus"), "healthy stomach", "intestinal/-like")
sel_samples$Cohort = "evPC SI vs Stomach"

sel_comps = c("SI_vs_Normal_AC")

data_si_vs_stomach_china = list(emat = tmp[, sel_samples$SampleID], anno = tmp_anno[, c("SYMBOL","PROBE_ID","TX_ID")], sample_description=sel_samples[, c("SampleID","Condition","Cohort")], dge = tmp_dge[sel_comps])


rm(tmp_ed, tmp_dge, tmp, tmp_mat,tmp_anno, sel_samples, sel_comps)
rm(im_china_env_dge)
```
